ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Advanced Broadcast Reporting This course is designed to help you hone your broadcast storytelling skills. Each student will work independently on a series of stories during the semester that will require high-level production elements. Some story topics will be assigned by the instructor, others will be proposed by you. You may choose to report for television, radio, or both. Limit 12 students
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
